items.name: Cubes Canes & Joy Vegas 2024

venue.name: Twitchell Elementary School
venue.details: The competition will be held in the cafeteria.

items.information: We are exited to keep the cubing momentum going with Cubes Canes & Joy Vegas 2024! We look forward to making new friends and welcoming back our veteran solvers. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesCanesJoyVegas2024#47590-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com), sponsored by [TheCubicle](https://thecubicle.us) and [Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers](https://raisingcanes.com/home/): [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzk2MzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--058eb6766f3c5d4ad04238b6fa2ed4bbd57f4932/wccTCCanes.png)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesCanesJoyVegas2024#46874-sponsorship) **More on this event including additional Information, Lunch and Live Results can be found on individual tabs above. Be sure to check out our Sponsors page!**

items.information: Bem-vindo à segunda competição de cubo mágico de Rondonópolis! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc3MjQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1d4a0ba0e26ca407e517c6ef29e450fafb7d0775/logo%20melhorada%20agora.jpg) **REGISTRO** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o número em questão (WhatsApp). 2. Será cobrada uma taxa de R$10 por acompanhante que também deverá ser paga pela chave PIX informada. 3. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do WhatsApp ou e-mail informado. 4. Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. 5. Haverá competição de modalidades não oficiais, sendo 3x3 mirror blocks e 3x3 debaixo d'água. Importante que aos competidores do embaixo d'água deverão trazer roupa de banho (bermuda ou maiô), óculos de mergulho e próprios cubos para a modalidade (quantidade que consiga montar sem respirar). 6. Acesse este link para entrar no grupo do WhatsApp para obter mais informações sobre o campeonato: https://chat.whatsapp.com/E1bkkzJDw8s4mEleyLljol --- Welcome to the second Rondonópolis Rubik's Cube Competition! **REGISTRATION** Participation in this competition requires the competitor to have knowledge of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration fee will be R$ 30, and payment should be made via PIX to the account 66999694243 (Allan Alves Furini Xavier). The payment receipt should be sent to the same number (WhatsApp). 2. A fee of R$ 10 per guest will be charged, and this fee should also be paid through the provided PIX account. 3. For additional information, please check the WCA website or contact the organizer via WhatsApp or the provided email address. 4. Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. 5. There will be competitions for unofficial events, including 3x3 mirror blocks and 3x3 underwater. It is important for competitors in the underwater event to bring swimwear (shorts or swimsuit), diving goggles, and their own cubes for the event (the number they can solve without breathing). 6. Click this link to join the WhatsApp group for more information about the championship: https://chat.whatsapp.com/E1bkkzJDw8s4mEleyLljol
